Usage drawn on a creature

This hard-to-read rune makes language difficult for the unfortunate rune-bearer. When the rune-bearer attempts a skill check or ability with the linguistic trait or attempts to Cast a Spell that doesn't have the subtle trait, they must succeed a @Check[flat|dc:5], or the action is lost.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-runesmith-assistant.pf2e-runesmith-assistant-items.Item.8SIxhCeZXpGDw4uI]{Effect: Oraloq, Rune of Inarticulateness}

Invocation The rune-bearer must attempt a @Check[will|against:runesmith] save as the rune puts a strong mental block on the part of their mind that interprets language. If the rune-bearer fails their save, they take @Damage[(20 + max(floor((@actor.level - 9) / 2), 0)*5)[mental]] damage (or double damage on a critical failure) the first time they use any language, take a linguistic action, or Cast a Spell without the subtle trait. The rune-bearer is aware of this and knows what will trigger the damage. The effect ends once the damage is taken or at the end of the rune-bearer's next turn, whichever comes first.

Level (+2) The damage of the invocation increases by 5.
